description: The finalized return or exchange (sync spec §6.1 SaleDocumentV2, POS spec §19, D-006, W1-13): returned lines first (negative quantity and line total, no list or floor, the refund per unit as unitPrice, what they return), then the sold lines as on a sale (the bill discount on them only); amounts with returnTotal (the refunds, positive): subtotal − lineDiscountTotal − billDiscount − returnTotal + rounding = total; kind return or exchange; the payments as settled (refund-tender.json); cash due (negative = a payout) and handover status pending whenever it isn't 0; overrides: the sold lines' price approvals (numbered after the returned lines), then the return approval as one override per kind (values {} for return_permission and return_outside_policy, the lines' suggested and approved prices for no_receipt_return), then refund_transfer (the method and the refund) for a refund by transfer; returnOf (id, number, business date) or noReceipt (ref). Every case runs on counter C03 as sale-document.json, at 10:00 on 2026-11-12 in Karachi (business date 2026-11-12), app version 0.10.0, seq 415. Original bill C03-S000412 (…412) of 2026-11-02; its line 1 is one pad (…c1) for Rs 4,350. Errors: no_return, approval_pending, return_customer_mismatch (a return from a customer's bill keeps the customer), invalid_tender, refund_approval_pending (a refund by transfer without an approval), note_required.
